judgment.rationale: The issue lists three always-visible Window Hopper defects with concrete expectations, and the owning overlay theme and thumbnail-layout code is already narrow.
evidence: The report says the background stays white in dark mode.
It says live previews spill outside rounded borders.
It says tall windows are cropped into landscape cards.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a maintainer-side repro against the current overlay theme and preview layout paths.

fix_assessment.rationale: The issue is repro-ready, but this fast pass stops short of selecting one rendering fix for all three visuals.

issue_context.summary: Window Hopper is reported to have three visual defects: wrong dark-mode background, unclipped rounded corners, and bad portrait-window cropping.
known_information: No reporter logs are needed to begin local validation.
inferences: The defect likely lives in overlay painting and preview cropping.
A current-main repro is the best next discriminator.
issue_context.analysis: AltWindowCycle.cpp paints the cards/backdrop and AltWindowCycleLogic.h computes preview cropping, so the issue is ready for a maintainer-side reproduce action.
initial_investigation: Reviewed AltWindowCycle.cpp for theme and preview painting.

actions.label: Reproduce Window Hopper visual defects
actions.note: Validate theme, rounded clipping, and portrait crop behavior.

reproduce.version: PowerToys 0.101.2362 or newer current main build
prerequisites: Open one wide window and one portrait-shaped window.
steps: Invoke Window Hopper so the thumbnail overlay appears.
Verify whether the overlay background follows dark mode.
Inspect whether the live preview escapes the rounded card border.
Cycle to a tall window and verify whether the preview is still forced into a landscape crop.
reproduce.expected_result: The overlay should follow dark mode, keep thumbnails inside rounded cards, and preserve portrait-window aspect behavior.

confidence.rationale: Symptoms and owning code are both clear.
